snippet.title: Lythe the Forgetful Witch Demo Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Lythe the Forgetful Witch is a visual novel that reimagines the classic tale of The Wizard of Oz, featuring horror monsters in a spooky land called Samhain, which exists in perpetual night. Follow the naïve young witch, Lythe, as she navigates her journey to find the High Witch of Samhain with her apathetic Sphinx cat Bartholomew and a disgruntled grimoire named Grimm. Along the way, Lythe's friendships spark change, helping each character pursue their deepest desires—whether it's a brain, heart, or courage.

Engage in spell crafting, seek runes, and play memory games as you guide Lythe to rediscover her magical abilities and influence the fate of her companions!

Available on itch.io
Coming soon to Steam
Kickstarter will Launch on April 2nd! (Pre-Launch page coming soon)
